title: Pure Cyberdark

allow.Cyber Dragon: Shared Cyber card that Cyberdark needs by name: Cybernetic Horizon wants a second Attribute and Cyberdark Wurm sends a Cyber Dragon monster to summon itself.

summary: Cyberdark cards with generic Machine Fusion support and staples, plus one shared Cyber Dragon; the Cyber Dragon list covers the rest of that engine. The Cyberdark Dragons Cannon and Claw discard themselves to search the deck, and the Cyberdark Machines equip a small Dragon from the GY when Normal Summoned. Cyberdark Realm searches a Cyberdark and grants an extra Normal Summon. Cybernetic Horizon, always treated as Cyberdark, sends a Cyberdark and a Cyber Dragon and searches. Cyberdark Chimera searches Power Bond and makes the GY a Fusion Material zone. Cyberdark Wurm, the newest card, counts as Cyber Dragon and summons itself once per Duel. Cyberdarkness Dragon and Cyberdark Dragon then equip Dragons and negate. Cyber End Dragon sits in the Extra Deck for Horizon to send and as the material Cyberdark End Dragon names.
main: Cyberdark Cannon
Discards to search a Machine Cyberdark; draws when sent from equip.
Cyberdark Claw
Discards to search a Cyberdark Spell/Trap; recovers a Cyberdark from equip.
Cyberdark Edge
Normal Summoned: equips a small Dragon from the GY and attacks directly.
Cyberdark Horn
Normal Summoned: equips a small Dragon from the GY; piercing damage.
Cyberdark Keel
Normal Summoned: equips a small Dragon from the GY; burns on a kill.
Cyberdark Chimera
Discards a Spell/Trap to search Power Bond; sends a Cyberdark when it goes to the GY.
Cyberdark Wurm
Newest card: counts as Cyber Dragon; summons itself once per Duel and recovers a Cyber Spell/Trap.
Cyber Dragon
Allowed: the LIGHT Cyber monster Horizon and Wurm need.
Cyberdark Realm
Searches a Cyberdark monster and grants an extra Cyberdark Normal Summon.
Cybernetic Horizon
Treated as Cyberdark: sends two Cyber monsters and searches a third.
Power Bond
Generic Machine Fusion Spell that doubles the Fusion's ATK.
Cyberdark Impact!
Fusion Summons Cyberdark Dragon by shuffling the three Machines back.
Cyberdark Inferno
Field Spell: protects equipped Cyberdarks and replays a Normal Summon.
Cyberdark Invasion
Equips a monster from either GY or trades an Equip Card for a destroy.
extra: Level 10 from five Cyberdarks: equips a monster and negates on either turn.
Level 8: equips a Dragon from the GY and grows with your GY.
Level 12: unaffected by their activated effects; attacks once per equip.
Generic Machine Fusion: Horizon's send target and Cyberdark End Dragon's named material.
